correctness.rationale: For K_m m<=3, direct bond component-size distribution for tagged vertex: at m=3, sizes 1,2,3 with probabilities (1-p)^2,2p(1-p)^2,3p^2-2p^3. If each component is seeded independently with rate s, F_m=m[1-E(1-s)^K]; for m=2 F2=2s(1+(1-s)p). Subtract split 2F2 from concentrated F1+F3 to get p*s*(1-s)[2+6p-6p²-p*s(9-6p)] (p*s term is p times s). For p<=2/3 bracket positive, for p>2/3 exactly one s*=(2+6p-6p²)/(9p-6p²), monotonically decreasing 1 to 2/3. For two-person household gap F2-2F1=2ps(1-s)>0. Independent SymPy checked full polynomial and threshold derivative, matching rational witness at p=s=.9. Proof is exact for all 0<p,s<1 and does not require simulation.
